concerns.text: The plan performs Wilcoxon signed‑rank tests on F1‑scores across only **5 random seeds**. With n = 5 paired observations the smallest attainable two‑sided p‑value is ≈0.0625. After applying the Benjamini‑Hochberg correction to the seven planned comparisons, **no p‑value can ever fall below the required FDR < 0.05** (SC‑003). Consequently the success criterion that “the statistical significance of the performance difference … is measured against the BH‑adjusted p‑value threshold of FDR < 0.05” is fundamentally unattainable, rendering the significance validation under‑powered and the claim of statistical significance unsound.
